audit.whatIsWrong: Radiant Blast is treated as slow poke you tank with W ('pop W to eat her Q poke'). Nothing on the page says what it actually does to a tank.
audit.why: Riot: 'Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that PIERCES THROUGH enemies, slowing, damaging, and REDUCING THE RESISTANCES of all hit.' It shreds the armour and MR a Galio just bought, and it pierces, so standing behind minions does not stop it. Every trade she opens with Q is a trade where your resistances are already lower than the sheet says — which is exactly the number 'tank through it' advice depends on.
audit.corrected: Resistance shred and the piercing behaviour written into the early text, mid, whys[1], the foe-wants line and the full layer's cooldown and interaction blocks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment is called 'her get-out at 6' with no cooldown, and the full layer says 'Reassess his ultimate too'.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80 — 160 seconds at rank 1, longer than your own Hero's Entrance at 180 only just. If she spends it, you own the next two and a half minutes outright. It also targets an ALLY, so it is not purely a self-peel: she can invulnerable someone else and it still costs her the same 160s.
audit.corrected: 160s stated at the level-6 phase, the cooldown block, the do's line and the trading rules, plus the note that she can cast it on an ally.

audit.whatIsWrong: Starfire Spellblade never appears in either layer.
audit.why: It is free — 0 mana — on a 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 cooldown, and its active 'deals bonus damage proportionate to their MISSING HEALTH'. Against a tank Galio that inverts the usual trade maths: the longer you stay in and the lower you drop, the harder her next auto lands, so an even-looking extended trade is not even.
audit.corrected: Named in the early text, the level 2-3 spike and whys[5], with the free-cast and missing-health scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math' names no source, and Kayle is called 'him' throughout the full layer.
audit.why: The heal is Celestial Blessing, a flat 15s that heals and speeds up both Kayle and her nearest ally — flagged as needs-antiheal in _missing-interactions.json. The move-speed half also matters: it is how she leaves your 275-range taunt after you commit.
audit.corrected: Itemization names Celestial Blessing; the move-speed escape added to the foe-wants line; pronouns fixed across the full layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts read Kayle at levels 2 and 3, while the content prose at those exact stages says Galio 'out-stats her hard' and that she has 'no answer'.
audit.why: Kayle before her ranged form has one 900-range ability and no dash; Galio at 3 has a knockup, a taunt and a tornado. The prose is right about the mechanics. I could not change the chart: 'Kayle' (5 chars) to 'Galio' (5) is the one flip that would fit the length band, but flipping only two rows of a chart the mirror tool also owns is a decision for the user, not a silent edit.
audit.corrected: Not changed. Flagged for the user; prose left accurate rather than degraded to match the chart.

edits.before: "Levels 1-3 are the start of your window, not hers. Kayle is a melee, range-less weakling whose only ranged tool is her Q (Radiant Blast) — and your W, Shield of Durand, actually shines here because it ramps damage reduction that's heavily amplified against magic, which is exactly what her Q deals. Pop W to eat her Q poke, then release it to taunt. At 2-3 with the Q-tornado plus E and W online you out-stat her hard: bait her in to last-hit, E-dash through her for the knockup, W-taunt, and drop the Q center column (it hits hardest) on her. She has no dash, no escape, and no R yet."
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are the start of your window, not hers. Kayle is a melee, range-less weakling whose only ranged tool is Radiant Blast — and Shield of Durand ramps reduction that is heavily amplified against magic, which is what her Q deals. Charge W into the poke, then release for the taunt. But know what her Q costs you: it pierces through minions and reduces the resistances of everyone it hits, so the armour you bought is not the armour you have. At 2-3 with the full kit, bait her last-hit, punch through for the knockup, taunt, and drop the centre column. Starfire Spellblade is free and hits harder the lower you are, so finish trades early.

edits.before: "Levels 4-6 are your peak in this lane. Keep landing E-knockup into W-taunt into the Q center column every time she steps up, and starve her of CS and XP so 6, 11 and 16 all arrive late. The bigger play, though, is using R globally: she's pinned to farm and can't follow, so flag it to mid or bot, win a fight, and snowball the map."
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your peak in this lane. Keep landing knockup into taunt into the centre column every time she steps up, and starve her of CS and XP so 6, 11 and 16 all arrive late. edits.before: "This is all Kayle. notes: Three facts this page never carried. (1) Radiant Blast 'pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit' — it shreds the armour and MR a tank Galio builds and minions do not block it, which changes the trade maths the page told the reader to rely on. (2) Starfire Spellblade costs 0 mana and its active deals damage 'proportionate to their missing health', so extended trades get worse for you the longer they run — the opposite of the usual tank read. (3) Divine Judgment is 160 seconds at rank 1 and can be cast on an ALLY, so it is both a huge punish window when spent and not purely a self-peel. Also fixed roughly a dozen 'he/his' references to Kayle in the full layer. LEVEL-CHART CONTRADICTION for the user: content win[] and full phases[].side both read Skill/Kayle/Kayle/Skill/Skill/Kayle/Kayle, while the content prose at levels 2 and 3 says Galio out-stats her hard and she 'has no answer'. Unusually, 'Kayle' and 'Galio' are both 5 characters, so this is the one matchup in my slice where a side flip WOULD pass the length check — but flipping chart rows also drives the mirror tool and the ratings, so I left it and raised it in questionsForUser rather than deciding unilaterally.
